title.zh-Hans: 为什么一个地方成为贸易中心，又怎样改变生活？
title.en: Why does a place become a trading centre—and change everyday life?

intro.zh-Hans: 从马六甲的港口网络出发，把地理条件、合作、维护与现代生活放在不同证据层次中阅读。
intro.en: Start with Malacca’s port network, while separating geography, cooperation, maintenance and modern everyday life into different evidence layers.

title.zh-Hans: 位置只是条件，不是命运
title.en: Location is a condition, not destiny

text.zh-Hans: 海峡位置提供相遇的机会，季风让航行形成节律；但商人仍需港口、仓储、交易安排与反复合作。距离的意义会随连接能力改变；靠近航道本身并不保证繁荣。
text.en: A strait provides opportunities to meet and monsoon winds give voyages a rhythm. Traders still need ports, storage, exchange arrangements and repeated cooperation. Connections change the significance of distance; proximity to a shipping route alone does not guarantee prosperity.

title.zh-Hans: 交易反复发生，才形成运行关系
title.en: Repeated exchange creates operating relationships

text.zh-Hans: 一批货物抵达港口，还没有完成交换：卸载、暂存、安排下一段运输与交接，需要不同劳动和能力配合。仓储让到货与出发不必发生在同一时刻，运输把不同地点的资源连接起来；交易安排则让参与者能够协调交付与交换。这里说明的是港口运行过程，不是对历史马六甲某笔交易的新考证。
text.en: Goods arriving at a port have not yet completed an exchange. Unloading, temporary storage, onward transport and handover require different kinds of labour and capability to work together. Storage separates arrival from departure; transport connects resources in different places, while trading arrangements coordinate delivery and exchange. This explains a port process, not a newly documented transaction in historical Malacca.

title.zh-Hans: 增长还需要维护，并会改变下一轮条件
title.en: Growth needs maintenance and changes later conditions

text.zh-Hans: 让下一批货物也能顺利通过，还需要持续维护设施、补充专业能力，并协调运输与仓储的可用空间。货物流动增加时，维持原有功能所需的成本和资源可能已经改变；吞吐量增加并不能单独证明仍有余量。扩展还可能提前绑定未来资源，因此要同时追问谁承担维护、哪些能力需要补充、下一轮运行依靠什么。
text.en: Getting the next shipment through also requires maintained facilities, renewed professional capabilities, and coordination of available transport and storage. As goods flows grow, the resources and costs needed to sustain the same function may change; higher throughput alone does not establish spare capacity. Expansion may also bind future resources. Ask who maintains the facilities, which capabilities need renewal, and what will sustain the next round.

title.zh-Hans: 历史参考：约1400—1511年的马六甲苏丹国
title.en: Historical reference: Malacca Sultanate, c. 1400–1511

text.zh-Hans: 现有历史图谱记录将转口贸易、港口收入、商人网络与季风航运连在一起，也记录港口、仓储、市场及船舶服务。记录采用历史重建范围，插画不是实况或考古证据。这个对象不是现代马六甲城市，也不是现代马来西亚的统计总体。
text.en: The existing historical atlas connects entrepôt trade, port revenues, merchant networks and monsoon sailing, with ports, warehouses, markets and ship services. These are bounded historical reconstructions; the artwork is not a contemporary photograph or archaeological evidence. The object is neither modern Malacca city nor the statistical population of modern Malaysia.

title.zh-Hans: 世界怎样进入工作、城市与生活
title.en: How connections reach work, cities and everyday life

text.zh-Hans: 数字交换、实体物流、城市与专业服务彼此依赖。用它观察生活，要把企业用工、通勤、住房、费用和服务记录分别核实，而不能从“贸易增长”直接推断所有人的生活改善。同一网络可能创造机会，也可能带来新的依赖，具体影响还需同一地点和时期的资料。
text.en: Digital exchange, physical logistics, cities and professional services depend on one another. Employment, travel, housing, costs and services need separate observations; trade growth cannot establish that everyone’s life improved. Networks may create opportunities and dependencies, while actual effects require evidence for the same place and period.

title.zh-Hans: 比较之前，先对齐对象与时间
title.en: Align objects and time before comparing

text.zh-Hans: 实时变化、年度统计与长期历史属于不同观察窗口。折叠的地区背景中，2023年马来西亚全国人口和GDP不证明港口贸易的增长、现代马六甲的就业，也不证明历史到今天的单一路径。仍缺港口同期开支、周转、就业与生活资料；应保留这个缺口。
text.en: Current observations, annual statistics and long historical windows are distinct. Malaysia’s national population and GDP for 2023, in the expandable regional background, are background not proof of port growth, modern Malacca employment or a single historical path to the present. Matching port, employment and everyday-life records remain missing.

title.zh-Hans: 一家企业怎样获得收入、维持经营并扩大规模？
title.en: How does a company earn revenue, sustain operations and expand?

intro.zh-Hans: 以NVIDIA两期公开披露读企业：收入、利润、现金与资产不是同一件事。
intro.en: Read two NVIDIA disclosure periods: revenue, profit, cash and assets are different measures.

title.zh-Hans: 先确定企业和真实期间
title.en: Start with the company and reporting periods

text.zh-Hans: 下面以NVIDIA为企业例子，数值来自公司公开财报。它们不是实时行情，也不代表美国整体经济。把两期记录放在一起，是为了读懂口径与已发生的变化，不是预测股价。
text.en: The company example uses NVIDIA’s public financial disclosures. These are historical records, not live quotes or a representation of the US economy. Comparing two periods helps explain measurement and past changes, not predict a share price.

title.zh-Hans: 从表内数值读出三点
title.en: Three observations calculated from the tables

text.zh-Hans:
① 收入由60,922增至130,497百万美元，增加69,575，增幅约114.20%（差额÷FY2024收入）。

② Compute & Networking占FY2025收入约89.04%，FY2024约77.81%（分部收入÷总收入）；这说明披露的业务构成变化，不解释未来需求。

③ FY2025净利润72,880，经营现金流64,089，相差8,791百万美元。收入记录销售规模，净利润是扣除相关成本费用后的会计结果，经营现金流记录经营活动现金流入与流出；三者不应互换，差额本身不能解释具体成因。
text.en:
1. Revenue rose from USD60,922 million to USD130,497 million: an increase of USD69,575 million, or 114.20% (change / FY2024 revenue).

2. Compute & Networking represented 89.04% of FY2025 revenue, versus 77.81% in FY2024 (segment revenue / total revenue). This describes the disclosed mix, not future demand.

3. FY2025 net income was USD72,880 million and operating cash flow USD64,089 million, a USD8,791 million difference. Revenue records sales; net income is the accounting result after relevant costs and expenses; operating cash flow records operating cash inflows and outflows. They are not interchangeable, and the difference alone does not identify its causes.

title.zh-Hans: 把收入、现金和继续经营分开看
title.en: Separate revenue, cash and continuity

text.zh-Hans: 第二册的资源流动视角帮助区分获得交易与维持交换；第三册要求继续追踪维持条件，而不是只看增长；第四册提醒，扩展还依赖资源网络、专业能力与可维护设施。报表能够记录部分财务结果，但不能单独证明组织韧性、未来需求或长期扩展一定成立。
text.en: Books II–IV distinguish resource flows, ongoing maintenance and the conditions of expansion. Financial statements record some outcomes; they cannot alone establish organizational resilience, future demand or guaranteed expansion.

title.zh-Hans: 六个指标，保留各自口径
title.en: Six measures, with their distinct bases

text.zh-Hans: 金额单位为百万美元。收入、净利润、经营现金流与购置支出采用完整财政年度；资产与权益采用期末数。购置支出具体指物业、设备与无形资产的现金流出，不与其他资本支出口径混用。权益比率是本页以股东权益除以总资产计算的期末比率，不是ROI、ROE、ROA或ROIC。
text.en: Amounts are USD millions. Revenue, net income, operating cash and purchases cover fiscal years; assets and equity are period-end balances. Purchases specifically include property, equipment and intangible assets. The equity ratio is shareholders’ equity divided by total assets, not ROI, ROE, ROA or ROIC.

title.zh-Hans: 记录能说明到哪里
title.en: What the records can establish

text.zh-Hans: 两期披露记录了已发生的企业财务变化；它们不是实时行情，也不能证明未来需求、股价或个人投资结果。
text.en: These disclosures describe past company finances, not live prices or evidence of future demand, share prices or personal investment outcomes.

financial.basis: GAAP; issuer earnings-release tables labelled unaudited
financial.verification: Official issuer and SEC pages read via web reader; direct issuer GET returned 403, not missing data
financial.equityFormula: period-end shareholders equity / period-end total assets * 100

title.zh-Hans: 怎样读一项化验记录：数值之外还要保留什么？
title.en: Reading a laboratory record: what belongs beside the number?

intro.zh-Hans: 这是一篇理解化验名称、单位与记录时间的健康公共知识阅读，适合从健康知识或检验记录阅读入口进入。以A1C为例，不读取个人检验单，也不提供地区公共卫生统计。
intro.en: A public health-knowledge reading for understanding test names, units and dates, suitable for health education or learning to read a laboratory record. A1C is the example; this is neither personal report assessment nor regional public-health statistics.

title.zh-Hans: 先确认它测量什么
title.en: Identify the measurement

text.zh-Hans: NIDDK说明，A1C反映约过去三个月的平均血糖情况，结果以百分比报告。它不是某一刻的血糖值，不能只凭数字大小把不同检验互相替代。
text.en: NIDDK describes A1C as a percentage reflecting average blood glucose over about three months, rather than a momentary reading. Different tests are not interchangeable merely because both contain numbers.

title.zh-Hans: 让记录保留它的背景
title.en: Keep the record’s context

text.zh-Hans: 阅读时保留检验名称、原数值与单位、采样日期、检测机构及报告自己的参考说明。比较前还要核对是否为相同检验与口径。这是资料阅读方法，不是本页对正常、异常或疾病的判定。
text.en: Keep the test name, original value and unit, collection date, laboratory and the report’s reference notes. Check that repeated records concern the same measurement and basis. This is a reading method, not a classification of normality or disease.

title.zh-Hans: 一本书不能代替医学依据
title.en: Books do not replace medical evidence

text.zh-Hans: 书籍中的观察窗口、维护与能力，可以帮助整理问题，但不能证明疾病成因或疗效。本页不提供诊断、治疗、剂量或个体阈值。个体解释应交给合适的医疗专业人员；可展开下方权威原文核对测量含义。
text.en: Book-based observation and maintenance concepts can organize questions, not establish disease causes or treatment effects. This page supplies no diagnosis, treatment, dose or individual threshold. Individual interpretation belongs with an appropriate healthcare professional.

support.quote: average levels of blood glucose, also called blood sugar, over the past 3 months
